executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors across multiple files. The root cause is missing Lombok annotations (@Data, @Builder, @Getter, @Setter) on entity and DTO classes, causing the Java compiler to not find auto-generated methods. Additionally, InMemoryTaskDataStore is missing the countByColumnId() method implementation, and ColumnNotFoundException has a duplicate constructor definition.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition in ColumnNotFoundException class. Likely caused by manually defining a constructor that Lombok @AllArgsConstructor or @RequiredArgsConstructor would generate.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove the duplicate constructor at line 9, or remove Lombok constructor annotations if manually defining constructors. Ensure only one constructor definition approach is used.

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO is missing @Builder annotation. The GlobalExceptionHandler expects ErrorResponse.builder() but Lombok is not generating the builder pattern methods.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to ErrorResponse class. Also verify @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations are present for field access.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getId(), setId(), getStatus(), setStatus(), getUserId(), getTitle(), getDescription(), getCreatedAt(), getUpdatedAt(), setCreatedAt(), setUpdatedAt(), getVersion(), setVersion(), getColumnId(), getPriority(), getAssignee(), builder()
errors.root_cause: Task entity is missing Lombok annotations. Multiple files reference Task getter/setter methods that don't exist because @Data, @Getter, @Setter, or @Builder annotations are missing or not processed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data and @Builder annotations to Task entity class. Ensure Lombok is properly configured in pom.xml and annotation processing is enabled in the IDE/build tool.

errors.message: InMemoryTaskDataStore is not abstract and does not override abstract method countByColumnId(String)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore implements TaskDataStore interface but is missing the countByColumnId(String columnId) method implementation.
errors.fix_recommendation: Implement the countByColumnId(String columnId) method in InMemoryTaskDataStore class. Return the count of tasks matching the given columnId from the in-memory data structure.

errors.root_cause: ColumnTaskCountResponse DTO is missing @Builder annotation. ColumnServiceImpl expects ColumnTaskCountResponse.builder() but the builder pattern is not generated.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to ColumnTaskCountResponse class. Verify @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations are also present.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method getStatus(), getColumnId()
errors.root_cause: TaskStatusUpdateRequest DTO is missing getter methods. Likely missing @Data or @Getter annotation, preventing Lombok from generating accessor methods.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation to TaskStatusUpdateRequest class to generate getters, setters, equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() in multiple DTO classes (TaskStatusUpdateResponse, TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse)
errors.root_cause: Multiple DTO classes used in TaskServiceImpl are missing @Builder annotations. The service layer expects builder pattern methods that Lombok should generate.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to all DTO classes: TaskStatusUpdateResponse, TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, and TaskResponse. Also add @Data for complete Lombok support.
